maps.description: The Ohre curls around an abandoned hill town. Faded plaster, broken tile roofs and a silent castle overlook the river. Cross the bridges, search the old quarter, and keep a route out of the valley.
maps.name: LOKET / RIVERBEND

maps.description: Abandoned residential blocks and shopping streets lead to the canal stone warehouses. Search timber homes, shuttered shops and port yards; use rear alleys to break the long street sightlines, then reach a clear rescue zone.
maps.name: OTARU / NORTH CANAL

maps.description: Abandoned tea courtyards, visitor facilities and village homes line a wetland lake east of Chengdu. Follow the broken greenway, use bamboo groves for cover, and choose exposed footbridges or longer wooded approaches to reach rescue.
maps.name: CHENGDU / QINGLONG LAKE
maps.terrain: WETLAND PARK / BAMBOO GROVES / LAKESIDE GREENWAY
